task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Select the right arm, grab the bright blue smooth stapler, and move it to the rectangular wedge-shaped displaystand
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入画面选择右手臂，抓住亮蓝色光滑订书机，将其移至矩形楔形展示架上
